reports.title: Foster’s 4-pound bass
reports.text:
Foster Gossen, 3, of Robert Cove and his “PP” Todd Hulin (grandfather) from Abbeville love fishing together. Every Saturday you can bet they are fishing together and making the best memories while doing so! Pictured above is Foster with his 4-pound bass caught at his Uncle Chad’s pond in Erath.
The post Foster’s 4-pound bass appeared first on Louisiana Sportsman.
